title: AfriStereo: A Culturally Grounded Dataset for Evaluating Stereotypical Bias in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly includes 'religion' as one of its five primary demographic axes for its benchmark dataset, AfriStereo. It evaluates how LLMs handle stereotypes related to various religious identities (e.g., Islam and Pentecostalism) and reports specific Bias Preference Ratios (BPR) for the religion dimension.
